claim: Try a ready client action room in one click
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /; activate the one primary action; assert /demo has the seeded Northline Studio queue

claim: Demo changes are sample-only and resettable
where: demo banner, landing privacy section, README
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; change and complete the sample approval in one; assert the other remains unchanged; reset the first and assert the exact seed returns

claim: A client can approve a request without creating an account
where: landing fact, demo client window, README
sandbox: fresh demo; publish the sample approval; open its client fragment link in a signed-out context; approve; assert completion without Entra navigation or account input

claim: Open requests are ordered by deadline
where: landing live preview, demo deadline rail
sandbox: fresh seeded demo with fixed clock; read all open action due times and assert ascending order with the overdue request first

claim: An approval records the decision, actor label, and server time
sandbox: fresh demo with fixed server clock; submit approval as Maya Chen; return to staff audit; assert decision, actor label, and exact server time

claim: An expired client link cannot read or submit the request
where: landing fact, share-link panel, expired client state
sandbox: fresh demo fixture with an expired token; attempt client read and direct submission; assert both deny content and the page asks for a new link

claim: A client PDF is type-checked, safety-scanned, and scoped
sandbox: fresh demo; publish only the upload action; assert an EICAR fixture is rejected, a PDF is accepted, and the clean result reaches the staff audit

claim: A client can choose one listed option through a scoped link
sandbox: fresh demo; publish the choice action; select the square crop; assert the exact option reaches the staff audit

sandbox: fresh demo; publish the external action; assert the host is disclosed, the server returns only its configured HTTPS URL, and the audit records the open without claiming payment

claim: Staff can schedule one reminder and see its audit record
sandbox: fresh demo; schedule a reminder for the open approval; assert the server time and staff actor appear in the audit
